description: Caller only says 'sometime next week' — no day, no date. The agent has to narrow that into something check_availability can actually search (a specific day once asked, or an after_date), not stall or guess.

caller.opening: Hi, I don't need anyone urgently — sometime next week would be great.
caller.persona: Nate Okafor, a homeowner in Austin with a slow bathroom drain. Genuinely flexible; only names a specific day if asked to pick one.
caller.goal: say you're flexible and want sometime next week, not a specific day, at first. If asked to pick one day, say Wednesday works. Accept whichever Wednesday (or nearby) window is offered.
